title: Improving Diffusion-Based Generative Models via Approximated Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: EDM 训练时 batch 内 Hungarian 图像–噪声指派近似 OT，ODE 曲率下降；CIFAR-10 FID 1.88@27NFE、加 DG 1.68/1.58
tldr_en: Hungarian image-noise assignment during EDM training approximates OT, straightens ODE; CIFAR-10 FID 1.88 at 27 NFE, 1.68/1.58 with discriminator guidance.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 unconditional: EDM 1.97 @35 NFE; EDM-AOT 1.95 @35 (rho=7), 1.88 @27 (rho=90, 14 steps) (Table 1)
With discriminator guidance: 1.68 (uncond) / 1.58 (cond) @29 NFE vs EDM+DG 1.77/1.64 @35 (Table 3)
8-step (15 NFE) unconditional best: EDM 4.05 vs EDM-AOT 3.06 (Table 4)
NFE sweep unconditional at 11/15/19 NFE: EDM 11.86/4.05/2.58 vs AOT 7.51/3.06/2.29 (Table 5)
Assignment pool N=512 (uncond) / 2048 (cond); training cost +2% to +15% (Sec. 5.1, Sec. 7)
